prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: environment background plate for an original Chinese infinite-flow survival RPG safe-hub HTML UI prototype.
Primary request: Original Chinese infinite-flow survival RPG safe hub, ash-survivor encampment inside a ruined old bronze-and-black stone cloister, hand-painted grounded dark fantasy with restrained retro-scifi.
Composition/framing: Portrait 1024x1536. Elevated near-orthographic 30-degree camera. Spacious empty stone courtyard in center and foreground. Weathered canvas shelters, workbenches, and practical survivor stalls only along the extreme left and right edges. The middle 60% must be readable clear floor for later UI and NPC overlays. An unobtrusive distant mysterious warm dim doorway on the upper axis. No large objects at foreground.
Lighting/mood: Warm small amber lamps and a distant brazier; quiet refuge among ruins.
Color palette: old gold and bronze fittings, desaturated charcoal and beige ash textures; preserve a black-and-gold game-family appearance.
Style/medium: hand-painted environment illustration, grounded dark fantasy with restrained retro-scifi. Not photographic, not a fantasy village, not cartoon.
Constraints: Environment plate only. No characters, no NPCs or monsters, no interface cards or buttons, no letters, text, glyphs, numbers or watermark. No clutter obscuring center. Opaque background.
